Mindful Living Collective (MLC) (a.k.a The Goods) is a retail store, restaurant, catering operation, and community gathering place in Soldotna, Alaska. The Goods carries local, sustainable, and unique products. Where It’s At! serves prepared food and caters events across the Kenai Peninsula. The building is also community home for the Kenai Local Food Connection, a nonprofit supporting Alaska’s local food systems.

MLC is an intentionally community-rooted business - one that tries to make values-aligned choices about what it stocks, who it hires, and how it operates. It is also, like any small business, a real financial enterprise that has to work.

MLC is asking the community to engage. Revenue in early 2026 is below what the business needs to sustain operations - the community gathering space, the local food network, and the market for local producers all depend on returning to a viable revenue level. Every dollar of revenue, every catering booking, and every new owner-investor matters.

This site hosts a living financial report built to track how the business is doing. It draws on Square point-of-sale records and QuickBooks financial history spanning November 2021 through December 2025 - assembled into a picture of sales trends, costs, customer patterns, and a path forward.

The full report covers:

  • Sales trends across 139 product categories
  • Full profit & loss history, month by month
  • Customer engagement and loyalty patterns
  • Catering revenue and customer history
  • Financial viability analysis

For a concise financial snapshot, the Summary Snapshot (above) is a good place to start.
